slides.title: Commission closes
slides.body: The National Dialogue Commission said its mandate is fulfilled and was set to close on Oct 24, The Reporter says.

slides.title: How it worked
slides.body: Consultations in 400+ districts, regions, federal bodies and the diaspora, then a national conference of about 4,000 participants.

slides.title: What is still unclear
slides.body: No public timetable, milestones or lead institutions for each recommendation. Records go to Parliament and the national archives. Speaker Ahmed Shide said the government will work to implement them.

slides.title: Inclusive dialogue. Transparent follow-up.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
